key_responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks and scripts
Develop and execute UI, API, and end-to-end automated test cases
Perform API testing using RestAssured and Postman
Implement behavior-driven testing using Cucumber and TestNG
Collaborate with development and QA teams to ensure test coverage and quality standards
Integrate automation suites into CI/CD pipelines
Manage test execution, defect tracking, and reporting
Participate in Agile ceremonies and support release validation activities
Maintain automation frameworks and improve testing efficiency

company_research.summary: TCS is a global IT services enterprise and part of the massive Tata Group conglomerate, employing over 600,000 people. While it is historically known for job security and a strong learning environment for automation roles, 2025 news reports indicate a significant shift, including layoffs of approximately 12,000 employees (2% of workforce) as the company pivots toward AI-driven models. For an Automation Developer, this means a focus on high-skill AI integration is likely required to stay competitive within their current "outcome-based" business strategy.
